paite: TOUPA aw, bang achia gamlapi a dingh nak na hia? Bang achia mangbat lai bang a kisel nak?
heading: Thudik A Vaihawm Ngetna

paite: Migilou-salou kisaktheihna ziak in migentheite delh in a-om uhi, athil gilou ngaihtuahkhiakte uah amau mah awk uhen.
Migilou-salou in alungtang ut lam asuang, mihuaiham in TOUPA apaikhia a, amusit hi.
Migilou-salou in kisaktheih melpu in, angaihtuahna ah, Pathian a-om kei, achi hi. Angaihtuahna tengteng tuh, Pathian a-om kei, chih ngen ahi.
A-omdante tuh chik lai peuh in leng akip a; na vaihawmnate tunglam gamlapi ah, amuh bat louh ah, a-om hi; Amah doute tengteng lah anuihsan maimah ngal a.
Alungsim in, "Ka ling kei ding, khang tengteng tan in mangbang in ka om kei ding," achi hi.
Akam hamse lohnate, khemnate, mengbawlnate in adim a; alei nuai ah thilhihkhelhna leh siatna a-om hi.
Kho teng a guktanna munte ah atu zel a; mundai ah khelhna nei lou mite athat zel hi, amit in tasam mite aguktan nak ahi.
Humpinelkai in akua a aguktan bang in ama'n mundai ah aguktan zel hi; mitasam man ding in atang zel a, mitasam aman ngei a, huchi in alen in akaimang nak hi.
Abokkhup a, akun a, bangmah hihthei lou amihatte uh hihpuk in a-om nak uhi.
Alungsim ah, Pathian in amangngilh ahi; amai asel a, chik mah chiang in amu kei ding, achi hi.
TOUPA aw, thou in; Pathian aw, na khut lik in, migentheite mangngilh ke'n;
Bangziak in ahia migilou-salou in Pathian amuhsit, alungsim a, na phut kei ding, achih nak?
Muh zaw na mu khin tham a; na khut a thuk ding thil hihkhial leh hihvuina na en a, migentheite na kiang ah akikemsak ua; pa nei lou panpihpa na hi.
Migilou-salou ban sutan inla, migilou, gitlouhna zongkhia in, na muh het louh mateng.
TOUPA tangtawn tangtawn a ding in Kumpipa ahi a; namte amah gam a pan in amangthang uhi.
TOUPA, kingainiamte deihna na ngaikhia a; alungtang uh na kisasak ding a, abil un leng na zasak ding hi.
Pa neiloute leh nuaisiah a omte, leitung mi'n a-engbawl nawnlouhna ding un, avai uh hawmsak in.
